spans.s: Tishya^1, name of a nakshatra (v. Su. Si.) = Pusnya. § 460c (Kalkin): III, 190, 13099 (yadā Sūryaś ca Candraś ca tathā Tº-Bṛhaspatī ekarāśau sameshyanti pravartsyati tadā Kṛtaṃ).

Tishya^2, name of the fourth yuga = Kali (q.v.). § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 10, 387 (enumeration of the four yugas), 388, 391 (ºe 'smin), 398, 399 (description of the T. age).-§ 668b (Pañcaśikhavākya): XII, 218, 7919 (yathā).-§ 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 341, 13092 (tatas Tºe 'tha samprāpte yuge Kalipuraskṛte / ekapādasthito dharmo yatra tatra bhavishyati, i.e. only a quarter will remain); 350, 13680 (punas Tºe ca samprāpte, then the Bhāratas named Kurus will be born from Vyāsa and dissensions will break out among them).
